images.filename: NB St Johns CR 5A @ Oyster Creek Bridge; St-Aug.jpg
images.caption: Northbound St. Johns County Road 5A as it approaches the bridge over Oyster Creek in St. Augustine, Florida. South of the intersection with Florida State Road 207 CR 5A has an intersection with Old Dixie Highway, a former segment of US 1 as well as hidden SR 5. South Dixie Highway ran north of that intersection until it crossed this bridge and ran straight ahead to reach former State Road 214. When the Florida State Road Department built a bypass of US 1 closer to the San Sebastian River, this segment became State Secondary Road 5A and later County Road 5A. By the end of the 20th Century, the county road was moved to Pellicer Lane.
images.alt: Northbound St. Johns County Road 5A as it approaches the bridge over Oyster Creek in St. Augustine, Florida. South of the intersection with Florida State Road 207 CR 5A has an intersection with Old Dixie Highway, a former segment of US 1 as well as hidden SR 5. South Dixie Highway ran north of that intersection until it crossed this bridge and ran straight ahead to reach former State Road 214. When the Florida State Road Department built a bypass of US 1 closer to the San Sebastian River, this segment became State Secondary Road 5A and later County Road 5A. By the end of the 20th Century, the county road was moved to Pellicer Lane.
